summary: Completed backend API regression and end-to-end UI/integration checks for Spatial AI capture, analysis, privacy modes, history, platforms, settings, and responsive behavior using external preview URL.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is green (6/6). Core UI capture/actions/models/private-mode/settings/platform-details checks passed. Re-test history listing consistency right after non-private analysis completion with marker-based search in UI.
rca of the issue: Repro: run non-private Gemini analysis, navigate to History immediately, search marker, UI may show empty while API returns record. Likely frontend state refresh timing/render inconsistency rather than backend persistence issue because /api/captures returns the saved item for same marker.
